notes.title: Seraphonin Finally Releases!
notes.notes:
Seraphonin has finally arrived to Steam! Get ready for a fast-paced action-packed journey through the profaned abyss! Prepare to die, complain, and conquer.

I'd like to thank my fellow peers and mentors for making this all possible, you're all awesome. I look forward to working on even more insane projects here.

- Audeus
